data.content_ref: inline:Enforce the closure rule already sketched for validity_node in `att` construction: every attacker of a warrant's validity_node also attacks the warrant's carriage edge (and hence the target artifact), and make carriage a first-class relation so attack edges carry warrant provenance. This strengthens the refutation route from 'attacker attacks artifact' to 'attacker attacks the warrant that makes the artifact a target', which is more causally precise and auditable. The construction remains a deterministic local closure over registered warrants (O(W+E) with W warrant count), so the grounded fixpoint's determinism and polynomial cost are untouched; reinstatement remains derived because labels are still a pure function of the resulting graph. Committed roots are unaffected because no new warrant is invented, only edges implied by existing warrants are materialized.
